scope: Complete indoor scene generation remains the endpoint; current evidence is a small development trajectory corpus.

variables.X: Task, current actual scene, available knowledge, ordered views and tool receipts
variables.D: Public annotated or model-produced decision proposal, not private reasoning or execution truth
variables.m_i: Whether unit i has a supervised D: 10/24; 8 sourced applications plus 2 termination statements

losses.coefficient_contract: Each L is the weighted sum of original causal target-token NLLs. Repartitioning does not renormalize coefficients by new stage length or duplicate target mass.
losses.primary_estimand: Effect of auxiliary reason prediction versus explicit reason-conditioned action training and their deployment policies, not a pure correct-pairing effect.
losses.optional_mixed: For annotated action states, 0.5*L_A(A|X,D)+0.5*L_A(A|X); all D and unannotated A targets retain original mass.
losses.optional_estimand: After actual training, fixed-parameter generated-D versus direct-action deployment on supported contexts; not measured here.
losses.optional_limit: Adds forward compute, does not remove teacher-to-generated D shift, and does not annotate the 14 missing-D states.

ordinary_baselines: Frozen base with identical task, available source knowledge and tools
Same-material auxiliary rationale supervision, informed by Distilling Step-by-Step
Declared-rule validation and bounded geometry/search using the same tools and budget
evaluation_contract: Primary execution uses the model's own generated proposal, never a teacher prefix.
Both arms share initial scene, assets, legal operations, source knowledge and task checks.
Refresh observations from each arm's own actual post-action state; do not splice archived downstream responses.
Report direct-action efficiency as well as any two-pass compute-matched diagnostic. Count failed generation and tool attempts.
An action change under D intervention does not by itself establish correct physical behavior or causal faithfulness.
Measure full trajectory and complete-room requirements, preservation, unknowns and cost; no claim from teacher-forced NLL alone.

data_views.original_open_book: All six cards are available; legitimate knowledge-assisted task, not unseen source text.
data_views.source_filtered: Remove held-source cards from BOTH train and evaluation, use identical canonical serialization in both compared conditions. Does not certify removal of all source cues or pretraining knowledge.
data_views.source_and_template_grouped: Group source families sharing exact supplied structural bounds/transforms. This proxy does not assert full geometric equivalence.
data_views.known_principle_new_space: Requires independent application conditions; the five supervised principles currently each have one application family only.
data_views.development_only: All current units have already been inspected. No new sealed test set is created by repartitioning.

theory_limits: Self-generated D from fixed X and independent sampling randomness provides no new environmental observation conditional on X; it can still change effective computation and actions.
Teacher D may contain target-action information. Lower conditional NLL is not evidence of improved free execution.
Both arms may learn the same knowledge from auxiliary supervision. Explicitly conditioning on D is not guaranteed to help and may amplify a mistaken proposal.
Unseen project names do not imply unseen geometry, unseen source principles or independent semantic supervision.
Multiple valid scenes may satisfy the task. Exact action imitation is a fitting check, not the final utility objective.
